The retained handbook text is the procedure source here; its references to ASTM D4442/D4444 do not mean those complete standards were acquired or that ASTM conformity is claimed.

full_context_review.scope: Complete actual H2 5 and9 prose and source-unit spans; no fixed section5 paragraph minimum or language-length heuristic. Cross-section applicability/meaning is independently reviewed separately.

actual_stored_projection_bodies.scope: All12 protocol fields, complete calculation/input/output, quality requirements/evidence, all measurement/property/unit bodies, source records, full row descriptions/amount evidence/basis/ranges, boundary/allocation/validation and reference fields. measurementRules.rule: Q is the sum of individually traceable complete buildings first quality-released in the cohort, at their measured net release mass. Use cp_reference: calibrated whole-unit weighing with tare subtraction or independently weighed disjoint supplied-item reconciliation with uncertainty. Include actual retained components and water once. Exclude packaging, transport trailer, rejected units and internal modules. Count only the first release; neither dispatch nor reinspection creates production.

The selected manufactured wooden-prefabricated-building Product has a verified Mass/kg reference chain. Its broad family is narrowed to the complete single-unit configuration throughout the reference and finished-row description. Recheck the complete native reference-property → exact unit-group → reference-unit chain for any future alternative binding. If native Count or Area is selected, preserve that native property and derive any kg bridge from the same complete configuration measured under cp_reference. Item(s) and item are the same count with factor 1; they give no kg per building. Never infer mass or density from a secondary property coefficient.

Survey floor area from the actual floor plan: identify each storey, single counted horizontal floor face, exclusions, openings and perimeter convention. Do not substitute bounding-box area, façade area, double-sided board area or an invented storey height. For sheet or timber conversions use actual thickness/net geometry and independently measured matched-state mass/density; do not assume timber density or count-to-mass factors.

measurementRules.applies_to: each wood article formulation and stock
measurementRules.rule: Collect dry-basis wood moisture u=(wet-oven_dry)/oven_dry separately for each species/stock state, and wet-basis fraction w=(wet-oven_dry)/wet; convert percentages to fractions. No numeric moisture is prescribed. Retained whole-article water and subcomponents are nonadditive subledgers. Track atmospheric sorption/desorption separately; it is not repair. Independently measure biogenic/fossil C and actual chemical species. Free water, structural water and any evidenced reaction water are distinct; one residual cannot fit two unknowns.

Retain original readings and conversions before attribution: kWh×3.6 gives MJ; fuel uses actual mass or measured volume/density and batch heating value. Integrate a genuine rate over its recorded time; an already integrated volume is not multiplied by time again. Gas volume requires actual species/state/T/P and moisture convention. Density is independently measured for that material and state, never borrowed from water. Purchased heat/steam is not implied by an electrical workshop.

calculationRules.rule: For Q>0, reported physical exchange = V/Q and reported environmental exchange = A/Q. For service records Q means the original released cohort Qc, separately for each original configuration and cohort, not current output. V is the actual gross native-unit boundary amount for that row and cohort; A is the converted and actually attributed raw exchange burden vector after inherited stock conservation. Choose one represented layer per exchange, not both as extra purchases. This is the only division; cards and protocol aggregation refer to its result and never divide again. Q=0 retains all true V/A and stock vectors without a per-unit result.

For each actual wet material and relevant conserved element: O_raw+O_WIP+O_nonWIP+I_phys+ER_pre+U_air+H2O_in=C_raw+C_WIP+C_nonWIP+T_accept+W_man+E_man+EO_pre+T_other+H2O_out. Each term is actual and disjoint; I_phys contains whole supplied material and carrier water once, and separate H2O terms exclude water already included in another whole leg or release. For an actually reactive species i add independently established G_i on the input side and C_i on the output side; do not add chemical creation to total mass/elements or fit one residual to unknown water/species. T_accept is an actual internal physical handover, never another external output or a closure-defined Q0. Packaging and fleets have separate gates. T_other consists only of named actual atomic transfers. X only deduplicates independently identified OTHER same-side flow terms, not stocks, true increments or opposite movements.

O_FG+T_accept+ER_FG+I_incremental+J_in+H2O_in=C_FG+S_gross+EO_FG+W_FG+E_FG+J_out+H2O_out at actual wet state. I_incremental is the FULL actual additional supplied matter, including real carrier water, not only the part retained in C; its retained part, whole waste and release are independently reconciled. J/water terms are actual additional disjoint transfers absent from other whole legs; sorption/desorption is real water movement, not repair. Preserve all failed/refused gross movements, complete C and original burdens. For truly reactive species keep G_i/C_i independently; inherited environmental vectors are a separate account, not conserved physical molecule amounts.

Add the actual manufacturing and FG-service physical equations and cancel one matching internal T_accept only. Retain every opening/closing raw/WIP/non-WIP/FG/return state, actual gross external shipment/return, full new matter, waste, release and disjoint water movement. Q0 remains an independently fixed reference-event account; do not add Q0 plus external shipment as two physical products. Every inherited environmental exchange follows its original cohort and actual handovers separately, once; provider embedded history and own foreground history remain disjoint.

For each actual whole wet PE-film, wooden-skid or steel-rack pool use O_empty+O_attachedWIP+O_attachedFG+O_reusable+P+I_sup+ERin+J_in+H2O_in-X_in=C_empty+C_attachedWIP+C_attachedFG+C_reusable+S_gross+EOout+W_whole+J_out+H2O_out-X_out. I_sup is actual disjoint supplier-included packaging, not another purchase; internal reuse R_internal cancels between matched positions and is not I_sup. J is additional real non-water material and H2O is additional actual water transfer only to the extent not already included in another whole wet leg. O/C and every whole leg retain all contained matter: actual new material/water retained in C never erases its true influx. X subtracts only independently proved overlap with OTHER same-side flow terms, never C, real increments, opposite directions or card existence. Trace actual J/water sources/destinations with specific physical records and internal pairs; do not invent a generic provider, extra Q, separate constituent waste or balancing flow. Gross shipments, external returns received/sent and true whole waste stay physically full regardless of environmental use shares. These three specific article pools are conditional on actual configuration; the source proves wrapping/packing but no universal material, tare, repair, water uptake or mass.

For each exchange and stock/cohort ID conserve opening inherited burden plus real incoming/added burden equals closing inherited burden plus burden actually transferred to first-release products, external returns, real other systems and wastes. Keep all attempt/idle/cleanup/rework loads and explain their actual causal attribution. Q=0 loads remain measured and retained. For observed post-release services report real additional A_service/Qc once with the original cohort, separate from its existing production burden. No fictional fixed inventory share, disappearing old burden or new output on reacceptance.

Gross return first leaves its old delivery position. Dispatch, return, repacking, retest or reacceptance never creates new Q. Current surviving wet mass and original water/material losses cannot both be restored and counted again. Opening old cohorts and later observed-H services use original Qc/Q0, not current output; delivery plus closing FG is sufficient only when all other postgate states/exits are absent. collectionProtocols.raw_fields: actual substance/CAS; phase; air/water medium; gross/net convention; sample/time; concentration; actual integrated volume or rate; T/P/humidity; control outlet; biogenic/fossil origin; independent sorption/moisture; detection limits; applicable_complete_method; actual_phase_preservation_matrix; analyte_spike_recovery; unknown_essential_procedure_status;
collectionProtocols.collection_method: Use real species-resolved measurements and matched flow/time/state records; separate each substance/medium and carbon origin. Natural H2O uptake/desorption is measured independently. For any real combustion/air throughput, separately measure N2/O2/Ar/H2O and each actual reaction/exhaust species in and out using explicit gross/net scope before complete closure; no assumed air composition or residual-fit species. Indicators remain nonadditive observations.  Use complete EPA320 only for actual identified IR-active vapor species and its real extractive heated-transport/reference-spectrum/interference/analyte-spike recovery programme. It is not total-VOC chemistry, a dust method, or FTIR measurement of homonuclear O2/N2/monatomic Ar. EPA5 supplies filterable particulate sampling/recovery/gravimetry only within its stated phase and source conditions; actual wood/OSB/mineral/coating particulate is a measured whole physical mixture, not elemental C or a fictitious pure resin. Captured dust is Waste and is separate from the actual final air release. Actual collected condensate/mist goes whole to its real receiver; final released species/medium require their own applicable procedure, not a dry-PM assertion about all phases. Do not infer actual formulation constituents or release from a generic supplier label. Actual on-site combustion needs its complete producer/fuel/air/O2/water-generation/each real species/ash/energy/control unit, not CO2 alone or a purchased-heat stub; add those specific interfaces and actual procedures before data completeness. This source set does not establish a full programme for every unidentified formulation, reacting species or condensable/other phase: a genuinely necessary unestablished procedure remains hold. Actual-site calibration/lot QA within an established applicable programme remains study qualification, not proof no method exists; finite check never approves science, performance or study results. The retained Method5 explicitly incorporates Methods1–3; the full originals are also retained here for actual duct geometry/traverse, calibrated velocity/pressure/temperature/flow and dry-gas-density procedure. Respect non-cyclonic/size/location limits rather than claiming every room or duct is covered. An actual uncontained fugitive release is not automatically represented by one duct or personal-exposure result. Method3 discloses its restricted gas matrix, interferences and unabsorbed N2/CO remainder and its argon omission: no nominal air composition/dry molecular weight, pure N2 flow or measured Ar is inferred. Method320 PDF16 prints a tracer spiked/direct fraction in Eq3 and a fraction-mixing Eq4 but labels DF>=10; preserve that actual inconsistency, not a numerical default. On a common corrected mole basis, use the actual conserved mixture fraction phi=(tracer_spiked-tracer_native)/(tracer_direct-tracer_native), with a nonzero denominator, representative matched samples and the stated no-unaccounted-loss mixing conditions; expected analyte=phi*analyte_direct+(1-phi)*analyte_native. Distinguish phi from its reciprocal dilution ratio, validate actual recovery and retain failed/negative results and uncertainty. This mathematical identity supplies no source concentration, acceptance tolerance, emission factor or factory QA success. These are dated EPA Internet copies, not an assertion of current regulatory conformity.

measurementRules.rule: Q 为该批次逐件可追溯的完整建筑首次质量放行时实测净质量之和。采用 cp_reference：经校准的整件称重并扣除皮重，或独立称量的不重叠供货项目质量衔接并保留不确定度。实际内含构件与水仅计一次。排除包装、运输拖车、拒收品及内部模块。只计首次放行；发运或重验不创造产量。

measurementRules.applies_to: 参考流及每项数据库绑定
measurementRules.rule: 选定已制造木预制建筑 Product 已核验 Mass/kg 参考链。其宽泛产品族在参考流及成品卡描述中始终限定为完整单体配置。今后任何替代绑定均须重新核查完整原生参考属性 → 精确单位组 → 参考单位链。如选定原生 Count 或 Area，则保留该原生属性；任何 kg 衔接须由 cp_reference 测量同一完整配置。Item(s) 与 item 均为件数，系数为 1，不提供单座建筑 kg。不得从次级属性系数推算质量或密度。
由实际平面图测量建筑面积：明确每层、仅计一次的水平楼面、排除项目、洞口及边线约定。不得用包围盒面积、立面面积、双面板面积或编造层高代替。板材及木材换算采用实际厚度／净几何和独立测量的同状态质量／密度；不假定木密度或件重系数。

measurementRules.applies_to: 每项木材制品制剂及库存
measurementRules.rule: 每种木种／库存状态分别采集干基含水率 u=(湿质量-绝干质量)/绝干质量，以及湿基分数 w=(湿质量-绝干质量)/湿质量；百分数须转分数。不规定数值含水率。整件制品留存水与组分为非加和子账。自然吸脱湿单独记录，并非修理。独立测量生物源／化石碳与真实化学物种。游离水、结构水和有证据的反应水分别核算；一个残差不能拟合两个未知量。
分配前保留原始读数和换算：kWh×3.6 得 MJ；燃料采用实际质量，或实测体积／密度与批次热值。真实速率按记录时长积分；已积分体积不得再次乘时间。气体体积需实际物种／状态／温压及干湿约定。密度须对该物质及状态独立测量，不借用水密度。电力车间不意味着存在外购热或蒸汽。

calculationRules.rule: Q>0 时，报告物理交换 = V/Q，报告环境交换 = A/Q。服务记录中的 Q 指原放行批次 Qc，按每个原始配置和批次分别核算，而非当前产量。V 为该行该批次真实毛原生单位边界量；A 为经换算、真实归属并完成继承库存守恒的原始交换负荷向量。每项交换选择一种表示层，不把两层都增加为采购。本条是唯一除法；卡片及协议汇总引用其结果，不再除。Q=0 时保留全部真实 V／A 及库存向量，不输出单位结果。

每项真实湿物料及相关守恒元素采用O_raw+O_WIP+O_nonWIP+I_phys+ER_pre+U_air+H2O_in=C_raw+C_WIP+C_nonWIP+T_accept+W_man+E_man+EO_pre+T_other+H2O_out。各项真实且互斥，I_phys含整份供入物料及载水一次，额外H2O项排除已含另一整腿或释放的水。真实反应物种i在输入侧加独立建立G_i、输出侧加C_i，不在总质量/元素中另造化学生成或用一个残差拟合未知水/物种。T_accept为实际内部实物交接，不是另一外部输出或按闭合确定的Q0。包装和设备群另设门。T_other仅由具名真实原子交接组成。X只去重独立识别与其他同侧流量项的重复，不冲存量、真实增量或反向流。

实际湿态下O_FG+T_accept+ER_FG+I_incremental+J_in+H2O_in=C_FG+S_gross+EO_FG+W_FG+E_FG+J_out+H2O_out。I_incremental是全部真实额外供入物料，含真实载水，不仅是留在C的部分；实际留存、整份废物及释放分别衔接。J/水项只含其他整腿未含的真实额外互斥交接，吸脱湿是真实水移动而非修理。全部失败/拒收毛物流、完整C及原负荷均保留。真实反应物种独立保留G_i/C_i，承继环境向量是另一账，不等于守恒物理分子量。
将实际制造与FG服务实物方程相加，仅抵消一笔匹配内部T_accept。保留全部期初/末原料/在制/非在制/成品/退回状态、真实毛外部发运/退回、全部新增物料、废物、释放及互斥水移动。Q0仍为独立固定参考事件账，不将Q0加外部发运当两个实物产品。每项承继环境交换另随原队列及实际交接一次流转，提供者内含历史与自产前景历史互斥。

每个实际完整湿态PE膜、木垫架或钢运输架池采用O_empty+O_attachedWIP+O_attachedFG+O_reusable+P+I_sup+ERin+J_in+H2O_in-X_in=C_empty+C_attachedWIP+C_attachedFG+C_reusable+S_gross+EOout+W_whole+J_out+H2O_out-X_out。I_sup为真实互斥供方已含包装，不是第二采购；内部复用R_internal在匹配位置间抵消，不是I_sup。J为额外真实非水物料，H2O为额外真实水交接，均仅限未已含其他完整湿腿部分。O/C及每条完整腿保留全部内容，真实新增物料/水留在C不删除其真实入流。X仅扣与其他同侧流量项独立证明的重复，不冲C、真实增量、反向腿或卡片存在。真实J/水源去向须具体实物记录及内部配对，不造通用提供者、额外Q、单独组分废物或平衡流。不论环境使用份额如何，毛发运、外部退回收入/发出及整份真实废物均保留完整实物。这三种具体制品池依实际配置条件启用；来源证明包装/包覆，不给统一材料、皮重、维修、吸湿或质量。
逐交换及库存／批次 ID 守恒：期初继承负荷加真实流入／新增负荷，等于期末继承负荷加实际转入首次放行产品、外部退回、真实其他系统及废物的负荷。保留全部尝试／空转／清理／返工负荷，说明真实因果归属。Q=0 负荷仍实测并保留。放行后已观测服务与原批次关联，真实新增 A_service/Qc 仅一次报告，与已有生产负荷分开。不虚构固定库存份额、不丢失旧负荷、不因重新验收新增产量。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 每份真实联单在其门称重一次，并保留独立实测 originW 子账，不虚构分项出口。混合总量或真正不重叠联单仅一次进入物理 LCI，链接一个供方；退回／拒收废物仍保留台账。  一次真实污染膜、垫架、运输架、机器、滤件、混合粉尘、拒收建筑部件或废液联单对应一次完整接收事件Qt，基材/制品、留存木/OSB/矿质/涂层物及水恰好一次包含。干皮重及实测originW/组分为非加和嵌套分析，除非边界前实物分离，不另作废物出口。匹配真实接收/处理/提供者及广延单位。实物Qt及Qt/Q展示不自动等于服务需求，只有有据兼容、不重叠服务A使用原Qc/Q0，实物交接仍完整。未知归属保持未知。仅算术示例：一份共享10kg联单不因25%归属缩为2.5kg实物，也不向每个队列重复收费10kg。不同干/湿或提供者单位须真实完整组成/状态桥，不隐藏换算或用纯组分代理。

collectionProtocols.collection_method: 采用真实物种分辨测量及匹配的流量／时间／状态记录；逐物质／介质／碳源分开。自然 H2O 吸脱湿独立测量。若真实存在燃烧／空气通过，则完成闭合前按明确毛／净范围分别测量 N2／O2／Ar／H2O 及各真实反应／尾气物种进出，不假定空气组成或以残差拟合物种。指标保持为非加和观测。  完整EPA320仅用于真实已识别红外活性蒸气物种及其实际抽取加热输送/参考光谱/干扰/分析物加标回收程序，不是总VOC化学、粉尘方法或同核O2/N2/单原子Ar的FTIR测量。EPA5只在其声明相态和来源条件内提供可过滤颗粒采样/回收/称重；真实木/OSB/矿质/涂层颗粒是实测完整实物混合物，不是元素C或虚构纯树脂。已捕集粉尘是Waste，独立于真实最终对空气释放。实际收集冷凝液/雾滴整份归真实接收者，最终释放物种/介质各需适用程序，不以干PM结论涵盖全部相态。不由通用供方标签推实际制剂组分或释放。真实现场燃烧需完整生产者/燃料/空气/O2/生成水/每种实际物种/灰/能量/治理单元，不能仅CO2或购热空壳；清单完整前补具体接口及实际程序。本组来源不为每种未识别制剂、反应物种或可凝结/其他相态建立全程序；真正必要且未建立的程序仍hold。已建立适用程序内实际场址校准/批次QA属研究资格，不证明方法不存在；finite check不审批科学、性能或研究结果。 已留存Method5明确引用Methods1–3，此处也保留其完整原件，以支持真实管道几何/测点、经校准速度/压力/温度/流量及干气密度程序。遵守非旋流/尺寸/位置限制，不宣称覆盖任意房间或管道。真实无组织逸散不自动由一个管道或人员暴露结果代表。Method3披露受限气体基质、干扰、未吸收N2/CO余量及氩遗漏，不据此推默认空气组成/干分子量、纯N2流或已测Ar。Method320 PDF16的Eq3为示踪物spiked/direct分数、Eq4也按分数混合，但图注又写DF>=10；保留此真实不一致，不设为数值默认。同一校正摩尔基准上采用真实守恒混合分数phi=(tracer_spiked-tracer_native)/(tracer_direct-tracer_native)，要求分母非零、匹配代表性样品及所述无未计损失混合条件；expected analyte=phi*analyte_direct+(1-phi)*analyte_native。phi与其倒数稀释比区分，验证实际回收，保留失败/负值及不确定性。此数学恒等式不提供来源浓度、接受容差、排放因子或工厂QA成功。这些为具日期EPA互联网副本，不宣称当前法规符合。

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 完整EPA320仅用于真实已识别红外活性蒸气物种及其实际抽取加热输送/参考光谱/干扰/分析物加标回收程序，不是总VOC化学、粉尘方法或同核O2/N2/单原子Ar的FTIR测量。EPA5只在其声明相态和来源条件内提供可过滤颗粒采样/回收/称重；真实木/OSB/矿质/涂层颗粒是实测完整实物混合物，不是元素C或虚构纯树脂。已捕集粉尘是Waste，独立于真实最终对空气释放。实际收集冷凝液/雾滴整份归真实接收者，最终释放物种/介质各需适用程序，不以干PM结论涵盖全部相态。不由通用供方标签推实际制剂组分或释放。真实现场燃烧需完整生产者/燃料/空气/O2/生成水/每种实际物种/灰/能量/治理单元，不能仅CO2或购热空壳；清单完整前补具体接口及实际程序。本组来源不为每种未识别制剂、反应物种或可凝结/其他相态建立全程序；真正必要且未建立的程序仍hold。已建立适用程序内实际场址校准/批次QA属研究资格，不证明方法不存在；finite check不审批科学、性能或研究结果。 已留存Method5明确引用Methods1–3，此处也保留其完整原件，以支持真实管道几何/测点、经校准速度/压力/温度/流量及干气密度程序。遵守非旋流/尺寸/位置限制，不宣称覆盖任意房间或管道。真实无组织逸散不自动由一个管道或人员暴露结果代表。Method3披露受限气体基质、干扰、未吸收N2/CO余量及氩遗漏，不据此推默认空气组成/干分子量、纯N2流或已测Ar。Method320 PDF16的Eq3为示踪物spiked/direct分数、Eq4也按分数混合，但图注又写DF>=10；保留此真实不一致，不设为数值默认。同一校正摩尔基准上采用真实守恒混合分数phi=(tracer_spiked-tracer_native)/(tracer_direct-tracer_native)，要求分母非零、匹配代表性样品及所述无未计损失混合条件；expected analyte=phi*analyte_direct+(1-phi)*analyte_native。phi与其倒数稀释比区分，验证实际回收，保留失败/负值及不确定性。此数学恒等式不提供来源浓度、接受容差、排放因子或工厂QA成功。这些为具日期EPA互联网副本，不宣称当前法规符合。
